## cycle-sync-training v0.1.2

- No code or documentation changes detected in this version.
- Functionality, usage instructions, and all details remain the same as the previous release.

cycle-sync-training v0.1.0

- Initial release providing cycle syncing workout planning for women, tailored to 4 menstrual phases with research-backed recommendations.
- Supports logging cycle phases and symptoms, workout program suggestions, training intensity adjustments, and energy peak prediction.
- Integration with OpenClaw platform via FastMCP 2.x server and Supabase user data.
- Triggered by various keywords related to menstrual cycles, hormones, and workout planning for women.
- Includes detailed API documentation and installation instructions.
